breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still instructs the use of the ideal-gas law to compute the density of liquid water, which is the core error. While it adds a note about the discrepancy with the actual density (~998 kg/m³), it does not replace the incorrect method with the correct approach (treating liquid water as incompressible with rho ≈ 998 kg/m³ and not using the ideal-gas law at all). The ground truth explicitly says 'do not use ideal-gas law for a liquid.'
